name: agy-orch
description: Call Codex from Antigravity to review plans, catch bugs, and run scoped fixes while skipping trivial edits and rejecting overdesign.
author: Ziyan Lin
suggestedPrompts: Decide whether this change needs a Codex review.
Ask Codex to review the current diff without editing files.
Delegate this bug fix to Codex and limit edits to the affected files.
